```{r}
# Install packages to use
library(tidyverse)
library(usmap)
library(readxl)

# Set working directory here
setwd("")
```

```{r}
# We're using Forest Inventory and Analysis data from New York State
# # Read in stand data
stand <- read_csv("data/fia_stand.csv") 

# Read in tree data, keeping only live trees
tree <- read_csv("data/fia_tree.csv") |> 
  filter(STATUSCD == 1)
```

```{r}
# Get forest type in tree table
tree <- tree |> 
  inner_join(stand |> select(STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT, forest_type), by = c("STATECD", "COUNTYCD", "PLOT"))
```

Merge to species-level table
```{r}
# Add Jenkins coefficients for species-level prediction (For Jenkins and CRM methods)
spp <- read_csv("data/REF_SPECIES_JENKINS.csv")

tree <- inner_join(tree, spp, by = "SPCD") 

# Add carbon content (C) of each species
spp_c <- read_csv("data/REF_SPECIES.csv") |> 
  select(SPCD, CARBON_RATIO_LIVE)

tree <- inner_join(tree, spp_c, by = "SPCD") 
```


```{r}
# Load biomass/carbon functions from Jenkins et al. 2003
source("eqns/jenkins.R")

# Load biomass/carbon functions from CRM method
## Load CRM functions
source("eqns/crm.R")

## Apply CRM functions
source("eqns/crm_ne.R")
```

```{r}
## Predict carbon for three methods (in kg C/tree)
tree <- tree |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(
    # Estimate carbon using Jenkins
         agb_jenkins = jenkins(JENKINS_TOTAL_B1 = JENKINS_TOTAL_B1, 
                               JENKINS_TOTAL_B2 = JENKINS_TOTAL_B2, 
                               DBH = DIA),
         bgb_jenkins = jenkins_root(JENKINS_ROOT_RATIO_B1 = JENKINS_ROOT_RATIO_B1, 
                               JENKINS_ROOT_RATIO_B2 = JENKINS_ROOT_RATIO_B2, 
                               DBH = DIA,
                               agb_jenkins = agb_jenkins),
         carbon_ag_jenkins = agb_jenkins * CARBON_RATIO_LIVE,
         carbon_bg_jenkins = bgb_jenkins * CARBON_RATIO_LIVE,
    
    # Estimate carbon using CRM
         carbon_ag_crm = BIOMASS_AG_CRM * CARBON_RATIO_LIVE * 0.45359237,
         carbon_bg_crm = BIOMASS_BG_CRM * CARBON_RATIO_LIVE * 0.45359237,

    # Estimate carbon using NSVB
    # For this, we can use the CARBON_AG and CARBON_BG columns from the FIA TREE table
         carbon_ag_nsvb = CARBON_AG * 0.45359237,
         carbon_bg_nsvb = CARBON_BG * 0.45359237,

    # Calculate total carbon (above + belowground) for each method
         carbon_total_jenkins = carbon_ag_jenkins + carbon_bg_jenkins,
         carbon_total_crm = carbon_ag_crm + carbon_bg_crm,
         carbon_total_nsvb = carbon_ag_nsvb + carbon_bg_nsvb
         )
```

```{r}
# Plot comparisons of carbon estimates for each method
# Jenkins vs CRM
ggplot(data = tree, aes(x = carbon_total_jenkins, y = carbon_total_crm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  facet_wrap(~ forest_type) +
  labs(x = "Jenkins estimate (kg C/tree)",
       y = "CRM estimate (kg C/tree)") +
  theme_bw()

# Jenkins vs NSVB
ggplot(data = tree, aes(x = carbon_total_nsvb, y = carbon_total_jenkins)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  facet_wrap(~ forest_type) +
  labs(x = "NSVB estimate (kg C/tree)",
       y = "Jenkins estimate (kg C/tree)") +
  theme_bw()

# NSVB vs CRM
ggplot(data = tree, aes(x = carbon_total_nsvb, y = carbon_total_crm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(se = F) +
  facet_wrap(~ forest_type) +
  labs(x = "NSVB estimate (kg C/tree)",
       y = "CRM estimate (kg C/tree)") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Calculate mean difference by forest type group
mean_diff <- tree |> 
  group_by(forest_type) |> 
  summarize(
n_trees = n(),
    mean_diff_jenkins_crm = mean(carbon_total_jenkins - carbon_total_crm),
    mean_diff_nsvb_crm = mean(carbon_total_nsvb - carbon_total_crm),
    mean_diff_nsvb_jenkins = mean(carbon_total_nsvb - carbon_total_jenkins)
  )
mean_diff
```

```{r}
# Write data table to use in the future
write_csv(tree, "data/fia_tree_carbon.csv")
```
